query: Community as a Service vs. an in-house community team
direct_answer: An in-house team offers dedicated internal ownership; Community as a Service provides flexible outside strategy and operating capability. The better choice depends on maturity, required speed, internal expertise, budget, governance, and whether the company needs to build the function before staffing it permanently.
best_for: brands and companies building or operating owned communities
teams that need strategy and operating ownership to connect
not_for: teams seeking guaranteed member growth or revenue
organizations unwilling to define member value or operating ownership
